other_failure_modes.name: Invalid Type Casting for Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: Forcefully casting the 'id' column to integers when creating the submission file can cause the script to crash (ValueError) if the dataset uses string-based identifiers (e.g. UUIDs or hashes).

summary: The agent developed a robust data processing, feature engineering, and model ensembling pipeline that meticulously avoids data leakage by fitting transformers and calculating statistics solely on the training data. However, the solution suffers from a critical execution flaw at the very end: it forcefully casts the test IDs to integers, which will crash the script if the IDs are strings. Additionally, the evaluation is narrow as it relies entirely on RMSE without considering other metrics.
